title: Illusion of Alignment: Detecting Hidden Disagreement in Collaborative Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2608.08210v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Collaborative dialogue can end with apparent agreement while participants still differ on goals, assumptions, or execution plans, creating an \textbf{illusion of alignment (IoA)}. A real-user study across 18 meetings confirms that IoA arises routinely in human collaboration. Yet IoA poses a paradox: if participants were aware of such disagreements, they would already be explicit; if not, they cannot articulate them when asked, leaving IoA invisible to both participants and observers. In this work, we make IoA detectable by generating diagnostic multiple-choice questions whose divergent answers across participants provide direct behavioral evidence of hidden disagreement. We construct \textbf{IoA-Suite}, a dataset and evaluation protocol for detecting hidden disagreement, spanning five task types and six domains. translated_title: 对齐的错觉：检测协作对话中的隐性分歧
translated_abstract: 协作对话可能以表面上的共识结束，而参与者实际上在目标、假设或执行计划上仍存在分歧，这就形成了“对齐错觉”。一项涵盖18次会议的真实用户研究证实，对齐错觉在人类协作中经常出现。然而，对齐错觉构成了一个悖论：如果参与者意识到这些分歧，它们就早已是显性的；如果没有意识到，他们在被问及时也无法将其明确表达，这使得对齐错觉对参与者和观察者而言都是不可见的。在这项工作中，我们通过生成诊断性选择题使对齐错觉变得可检测——参与者之间对这些选择题的不同回答为隐性分歧提供了直接的行为证据。我们构建了 IoA-Suite，一个用于检测隐性分歧的数据集和评估协议，涵盖五种任务类型和六个领域。我们发现即使是最好的模型也只能达到49.5%的F1分数，其瓶颈可追溯至对话中缺失的私有上下文信息。
tldr: 该论文首次提出并形式化了协作对话中的“对齐错觉”问题，通过生成诊断性选择题和构建IoA-Suite数据集，使参与者间的隐性分歧首次变得可检测，并发现即使是目前最强的模型其检测性能也仅为49.5% F1。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces and formalizes the "Illusion of Alignment" (IoA) in collaborative dialogue, making hidden disagreement detectable for the first time by generating diagnostic multiple-choice questions and constructing the IoA-Suite dataset, revealing that even the best model achieves only 49.5% F1.
